description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Tokenized real estate / RWA property tokens (RealT RealTokens on Gnosis) read on-chain: token, platform, chain, contract, property address, city, state, country, total supply, on-chain price + price source, market cap, holders, 24h/30d on-chain YAM volume and trades, last trade, RMM collateral, as-of. Covers RMM collateral tokens plus all YAM-whitelisted RealTokens. Filters platform, chain, city, state, country, limit. Returns JSON property tokens with address, city, supply, on-chain price, market cap, holders, trade volume, and RMM collateral.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Optional chain name. Format: the chain string the tool text names. Example: Gnosis. Omit for every chain in the feed.

city.description: Optional city filter. Format: city name. Example: Detroit. Omit for every city.

country.description: Optional country code. Format: a short code. Example: US. Omit for every country.

limit.description: Maximum property rows. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Omit for the server's current cap.

platform.description: Optional platform name. Format: the platform string the tool text names. Example: RealT. Omit for every platform in the feed.

state.description: Optional state or region code. Format: a short code. Example: MI. Omit for every state.

name: tokenized_real_estate
title: Tokenized real estate live feed, on-chain ($0.005)
